project.name: WLJ Transcribe Recordings
project.description: Audio transcription and summary module (Capture) - Record or upload audio, transcribe via Whisper, summarize with AI, export to PDF

description.objective: Set up the capture app with proper Django app structure and register it in settings
actions: Create apps/capture/ directory with __init__.py, apps.py, models.py, views.py, urls.py, admin.py, forms.py
Create apps/capture/tests/ directory with __init__.py
Configure CaptureConfig in apps.py
Register 'apps.capture' in INSTALLED_APPS in settings.py
Run python manage.py check to verify app loads correctly
description.output: New capture app registered and passing Django checks

description.objective: Define the CaptureEntry model with all required fields for storing audio recordings, transcripts, and summaries
inputs: Data model spec from feature plan
actions: Create CaptureEntry model in apps/capture/models.py with fields: id (UUID), user (FK), title, created_at, duration_seconds, audio_file_url, audio_expires_at, transcript, summary, category, subcategory, status, error_message
Add STATUS_CHOICES: uploading, transcribing, summarizing, ready, failed
Add CATEGORY_CHOICES: faith, organize
Add SUBCATEGORY_CHOICES: sermon, bible_study, devotional, meeting, notes, personal
Add __str__ and Meta class with ordering
Run makemigrations and migrate
Register model in admin.py
description.output: CaptureEntry model created with migration applied and visible in admin

tasks.name: Configure S3 storage for audio files

description.objective: Set up S3-compatible storage configuration for temporary audio file storage with lifecycle policies
inputs: AWS S3 or DigitalOcean Spaces docs
actions: Add CAPTURE_AUDIO_BUCKET setting in settings.py (separate from main media storage)
Add CAPTURE_AUDIO_RETENTION_DAYS setting (default 7)
Create utility function in apps/capture/storage.py for generating presigned upload URLs
Create utility function for generating presigned download URLs
Document required S3 lifecycle policy in docs/wlj_third_party_services.md
Add tests for URL generation functions
description.output: S3 storage utilities ready for audio file handling with documented lifecycle policy
